observed_failure.top_level_error: Model identity or completion status mismatch

interpretation: The retained metadata identifies unsuccessful completion, with a 403/permission signal. It does not establish the specific account, credential, endpoint, policy, region or routing cause. Being listed in the local registry is not proof of successful live access.
baseline_only_observation: The current judge identifies the repeated 97% clause but still praises the common correction and the separate null-probability correction. This unpaired valid report does not establish relative model performance.
disposition: Preserve both records. Do not retry, change model/provider or run remaining jobs under this freeze. Resolve provider-side access from authoritative request/account information before any separately authorized continuation; do not request or publish credentials.
